authorization.request: 用户明确要求修复商城与 DSH Desktop 的安装/更新交接，并已授权推送和发布。

objective: 发布 DSH Store 0.9.24，使 Store 提供安装审核建议，用户确认后由 DSH Desktop 官方 installBundle() 决定安装结果；无变更失败仅查询一次已安装清单并严格核对身份。

change.directory: Store 保留审核建议与固定来源校验；DSH inspect() 为建议，用户确认后调用 installBundle()，失败无变更时只核对一次 listBundles()。
change.lifecycle: DSH Desktop 决定安装/更新成功或拒绝；Store 不用 Catalog blocked 或 inspect() 提示代替 DSH 最终判定，不自动重试。
change.catalog: 仅更新既有 dsh-safe-plugin-manager 记录至固定合并 Commit；保留 web-only Profile、现有权限与第三方条目状态。

commands.expected: REGISTRY_OK and all repository checks pass

gates: Plan binds the fresh main Commit, exact merged source tree, and pre/post hashes for its bounded file scope.
The fixed-source review covers all distributable runtime files at the immutable source Commit, with exact hashes and a specific rationale for every scanner finding; no third-party code is executed.
Registry CI validates the release plan, Catalog schema, fixed source review, DSH release window, and unchanged third-party entries.
The Store Catalog self-pin resolves to version 0.9.24 and the exact merged source Commit; status and permissions remain unchanged.
Catalog blocked plugin statuses and review reasons remain unchanged; only DSH Desktop inspect/install responses decide the requested installation result.
Keep the Store Catalog Profile claim at web until real Desktop Profile acceptance is established.
After merge, independently read GitHub Raw, Pages, dsh.store, and dsh-store.cn.

rollback.source: Revert this exact Catalog commit through a CI-checked PR; preserve prior immutable Catalog history.
rollback.runtime: No real DSH Profile or package mutation is part of this Catalog PR. A real Desktop install remains separately verified by DSH.

healthCheck: The release-plan verifier and Registry CI pass; Catalog/index/detail pins agree on the fixed 0.9.24 Commit, third-party entries are unchanged, and each public surface is independently read back after merge.
